title: Bisma Rohpanca Joyosumarto (BismaBRJ)
text:
A recent Bachelor in mathematics from the University of Indonesia (https://www.ui.ac.id/), interested in many areas of mathematics, both pure and applied. Also passionate about teaching as well as programming. Can dabble in many related areas, such as data-heavy roles and economics, especially where mathematical modeling plays an important role.



Data & Software
Teaching & Tutoring




Computers are supposed to help us; I analyze data and build utilities with them, putting my STEM background to use.
Humans developed mathematics and technology; thus they must make sense if communicated properly. This belief fuels my passion for teaching throughout my undergraduate years and beyond.
